title: A Retinex-Based Approach for Low-Light Image Enhancement
abstract: We propose a Retinex-based approach that decomposes a low-light image into illumination and reflectance and enhances the illumination channel. Experiments on natural nighttime images show improved visibility.

title: Multi-Scale Retinex with Color Restoration for Nighttime Images
abstract: A multi-scale Retinex pipeline with color restoration is evaluated on nighttime street images, improving contrast of low-light images while limiting halo artifacts.

title: LIME: Low-Light Image Enhancement via Illumination Map Estimation
abstract: We estimate the illumination map of a low-light image by solving an optimization problem and enhance the image accordingly. Results on public low-light datasets show gains over histogram equalization.

title: Deep Retinex Decomposition for Low-Light Enhancement
abstract: A deep network learns to decompose low-light images into reflectance and illumination, jointly denoising the reflectance. Paired LOL dataset experiments show strong PSNR improvements.

title: Zero-Reference Deep Curve Estimation for Low-Light Image Enhancement
abstract: Zero-DCE formulates low-light enhancement as image-specific curve estimation with zero-reference training, removing the need for paired data.

title: Kindling the Darkness: A Practical Low-Light Image Enhancer
abstract: KinD decomposes images into illumination and reflectance with dedicated restoration modules, handling severe degradation in real low-light scenes.

title: EnlightenGAN: Unpaired Low-Light Enhancement with Generative Adversarial Networks
abstract: EnlightenGAN introduces a global-local discriminator for unpaired low-light image enhancement without ground-truth pairs. Only perceptual image quality is evaluated.

title: Self-Calibrated Illumination Learning with Transformers for Low-Light Enhancement
abstract: A transformer model with self-calibrated illumination stages improves efficiency and quality of low-light image enhancement on standard benchmarks.

title: Does Low-Light Enhancement Help Downstream Object Detection? Evidence for Gains
abstract: We apply Retinex-style low-light enhancement before a YOLOv5 detector on the ExDark dataset and observe that mAP@0.5 improves by +4.2 points, suggesting low-light enhancement helps downstream object detection.

title: Revisiting Low-Light Enhancement for Object Detection: No Benefit Observed
abstract: Repeating the Retinex-style low-light enhancement plus YOLOv5 pipeline on ExDark, we find mAP@0.5 changes by only -0.3 points, not statistically significant. Low-light enhancement did not improve downstream object detection in our setting.

title: Temporally Consistent Low-Light Video Enhancement
abstract: We extend low-light enhancement to video with a temporal consistency loss, reducing flicker across frames while preserving spatial detail.

title: Diffusion Models for Low-Light Image Enhancement
abstract: A denoising diffusion model conditioned on low-light images generates enhanced results with better perceptual quality than GAN baselines.

title: Benchmarking Low-Light Image Enhancement: A Comparative Study
abstract: We benchmark ten low-light image enhancement methods on paired datasets, comparing PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS. No method dominates across all metrics, and no downstream task metrics are included.

title: Low-Light Enhancement for Infrared-Visible Fusion
abstract: We integrate low-light enhancement into an infrared-visible fusion pipeline, improving nighttime scene representation for surveillance imagery.

title: Lightweight Low-Light Enhancement for Mobile Deployment
abstract: A lightweight low-light enhancement network with 0.8M parameters runs in real time on mobile devices with modest quality loss.
